sn20.3:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahutthikāni appapurisāni, tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
sn20.3:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettā cetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā, so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
sn20.3:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni appitthikāni bahupurisāni, tāni duppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
sn20.3:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettā cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā, so duppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
sn20.3:1.7: mettā no cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti.
